21 CFR § 820.45 — Device labeling and packaging controls. The manufacturer must ensure that the correct unique device identifier (UDI), expiration date, storage instructions, handling instructions, and any additional processing instructions are provided on the labeling and packaging.

EU MDR Article 83(1)-(2) — Post-market surveillance system of the manufacturer. The post-market surveillance system shall be suited to actively and systematically gathering, recording and analysing relevant data on the quality, performance and safety of a device throughout its entire lifetime.

EU MDR Annex I, Chapter II, Section 17.2 — Software development lifecycle and cybersecurity. claim_support.claim: The synthetic post-market surveillance queue reported a routine software validation finding for the atrial fibrillation detection pathway.
The CI/CD quality gate detected and blocked the release candidate before any clinical deployment, ensuring no patient was exposed to this event.
No clinician note is on file, but the automated CI validation gate acted as intended, containing the issue before it could reach a patient.
The engineering finding was fully contained pre-release or resolved as a non-event.

final_report.rationale: The synthetic post-market surveillance queue reported a routine software validation finding for the atrial fibrillation detection pathway. The CI/CD quality gate detected and blocked the release candidate before any clinical deployment, ensuring no patient was exposed to this event. No clinician note is on file, but the automated CI validation gate acted as intended, containing the issue before it could reach a patient. The engineering finding was fully contained pre-release or resolved as a non-event.
